status.en: 12 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 25% fewer than the week before, most of them in Baghdad, Kirkuk and Erbil.
status.nb: 12 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 25 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Baghdad, Kirkuk og Erbil.

summary.en: Iraqi courts have sentenced six French nationals to life imprisonment and a seventh to 15 years for Islamic State membership, while a separate court sentenced seven French citizens to lengthy terms for the same crime. Security forces have repeatedly intercepted unidentified drones near Baghdad's Green Zone, with multiple reports confirming the incidents. PKK-linked Yazidi militia units are disarming and joining the Iraqi army, and three militia groups have pledged to disarm by June 2027. Iran’s rhetoric has intensified, warning the United States over its stance, and the United States has warned Baghdad it will strike Iraqi militias that join Iran’s war. The conflict produced 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Irakiske domstoler har dømt seks franske statsborgere til livsvarig fengsel og en sjuende til 15 år for medlemskap i IS, mens en annen domstol dømte syv franske borgere til lange fengselsstraffer for samme lovbrudd. Sikkerhetsstyrker har gjentatte ganger avskåret uidentifiserte droner i nærheten av Bagdads grønne sone, og flere rapporter bekrefter hendelsene. PKK-tilknyttede yazidimilitære enheter avvæpner seg og slutter seg til den irakiske hæren, og tre militsgrupper har lovet å avvæpne seg innen juni 2027. Irans retorikk har blitt skarpere, og den advarer USA om deres holdning, mens USA har advart Bagdad om at de vil slå mot irakiske militsgrupper som slutter seg til Irans krig. Konflikten førte til 396 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Iraqi conflict
background.extract: The Iraqi conflict is a series of violent events that began with the 2003 American-led invasion of Iraq and deposition of Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein, followed by a series of conflicts including the protracted Iraq War (2003–2011), the Iraqi insurgency (2011–2013), the War in Iraq (2013–2017), and most recently, the small-scale Islamic State insurgency in 4 provinces located in Northern Iraq since 2017.
